readme.run: Turn the axial slices of a volume into a WebM video
notes: Input is NIfTI, MGZ/MGH, or DICOM files or folders; dcm2niix is included and reads compressed DICOM.
When a folder holds several DICOM series, the command lists them; choose one with --series-uid.
Add --help for every option: orientation, frame rate, slice range, labels, format and upscaling.
The video is VP9 (libvpx), in WebM as the web app writes it or in MP4 with --format mp4.
Windowing, rotation and stretching use the web app.
No network connection is required and nothing is downloaded.
